preconditions.expression: isinstance(E, str) and 1 <= len(E) <= 10**4 and all(c in '()123456789?' for c in E)
preconditions.description: E is a valid Ahmes arithmetic expression string with erased operators ('?') and digits 1-9, parentheses, and no spaces.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(P, int) and isinstance(M, int) and 0 <= P <= 100 and 0 <= M <= 100 and P + M == E.count('?')
preconditions.description: P and M are non-negative integers representing the number of plus and minus operators, respectively, and their sum equals the number of '?' in E.

postconditions.description: stdout contains the maximum possible value of the expression E after replacing exactly P '?' with '+' and M '?' with '-', where max_value is the highest achievable integer result.
